title: Launch '60-Second Money Tips' series → auto-publish to TikTok, Facebook & YouTube
description: Full content pipeline for the finance-education niche. Steps: (1) Topic & Trend Scout validates 5 trending money-saving topics for Gen-Z; (2) Character & Persona Designer creates the recurring host persona 'Penny'; (3) Content Plan Strategist builds a 2-week, 8-episode calendar with hooks, hashtags and KPIs; (4) Video Producer writes the shot-by-shot script + storyboard for episode 1 and exports the final asset; (5) Multi-Platform Publisher tailors metadata per platform and auto-uploads to TikTok, Facebook and YouTube. Definition of done: episode 1 live on all 3 platforms with links and a pinned comment.

title: Topic → Publish: 'AI study hacks for students' short-form video
description: Produce one short-form video end-to-end from the topic 'AI study hacks for students'. Scout the angle, reuse the studio host persona, draft the content brief, write the script/storyboard, generate the asset, and schedule auto-publish across TikTok, Facebook and YouTube. Optimize the hook for the first 3 seconds and include platform-specific captions and hashtags.

title: Company response: reduce mobile checkout abandonment by 30% in Q3
description: A business problem assigned to the taskforce. Business Analyst frames the problem (stakeholders, current vs desired funnel, requirements, success metric = -30% mobile checkout abandonment by end of Q3). Solution Architect proposes 2-3 options with trade-offs and recommends a design + roadmap. AI Engineer scopes the implementation. QA Specialist defines acceptance criteria and a verification plan. Project Manager sequences the work and assigns owners. Deliverable: a prioritized, costed action plan with milestones.

title: Post-mortem & fix plan: nightly data pipeline outage
description: The company experienced a 6-hour outage of the nightly analytics pipeline. The taskforce runs a structured post-mortem: BA captures impact and requirements, Solution Architect proposes resilient redesign options and recommends one, AI Engineer details the fix, QA defines regression tests, PM produces the remediation timeline. Deliverable: incident report + prioritized fix plan with owners and dates.

title: Customer problem intake & analysis: 'SaaS onboarding too slow, churn rising'
description: A customer reports that their SaaS onboarding takes too long and early-stage churn is climbing. Intake Specialist captures context, quantifies impact/urgency and logs clarifying questions; Problem & Root Cause Analyst diagnoses the underlying drivers (5-Whys / fishbone) using the provided data; Solution Advisor returns prioritized recommendations (quick wins + long-term fixes) and a customer-ready response plan. Deliverable: intake ticket + root-cause report + recommended action plan.

title: Analyze customer complaint: payment failures during peak hours
description: A customer reports intermittent payment failures during peak traffic. The desk receives the problem, intakes the details and reproduction steps, performs root-cause analysis correlating failures with load and third-party gateway timeouts, and delivers a prioritized solution plan plus a clear response to send back to the customer. Deliverable: analyzed problem report with root cause and recommended mitigations.
